$comment: KS-MODE-00 (home/docs/BACKLOG.md): the search source mode, declared once. Three values for the household key `search.source_mode`; the two per-source keys `search.source_mode.wikimedia` and `search.source_mode.web` take the same three plus `inherit` (follow the household value). `offline` is the narrow reading: it turns off only the Wikipedia-style live lookup, and web search, page reads, Wayback and the hosted provider stay on unless `search.source_mode.web` is itself `offline`. The mode is a ceiling for a child or teen, never a widening: a minor never reaches the live Wikipedia-style lookup or the hosted provider in any mode, and `live` changes nothing for them. Every `copy` line passes the settings copy lint (one sentence, at most 90 characters); `help` is the longer text a key's help repeats. The shipped presets (Minimum, Moderate, Full) all carry the setting value `search.source_mode = mix`; those values live in KS-REF-00's `reference-presets.json`, whose test checks the preset value is one of `values[].value`. Migration of the retired `search.wikipedia_fallback`: a stored `false` becomes `search.source_mode.wikimedia = offline` (never the household mode); a stored `true` or no stored value becomes `inherit`. The old key stays in keys.json in this tag and is removed in the tag paired with KS-MODE-01.

values.label: Internet first
values.copy: Tries a live lookup whenever the web finds nothing, even if the library has a match.
values.help: A live Wikipedia-style lookup is tried whenever web search finds nothing, even if the offline library already has a match. For children and teens nothing changes: they keep their current protections in every mode.

values.label: Library only
values.copy: Skips live Wikipedia-style lookups, and web search stays on unless turned off itself.
values.help: Turns off only the live Wikipedia-style lookup. Web search stays on unless web search is itself set to Library only in its own choice. The news shelf, link reading and integrations keep their own switches.

values.label: Library first
values.copy: Checks the offline library first, then tries a live lookup only if nothing turns up.
values.help: The offline library answers first. A live Wikipedia-style lookup is tried only when the library and web search both find nothing. This is the recommended choice.

override_values.label: Same as the household choice
override_values.copy: Follows the household choice for where answers come from.

web_copy.live: Goes to the internet even when the library already has a match.
web_copy.offline: Turns off web search, link reading, Wayback and the hosted provider.
web_copy.mix: Goes to the internet after the library, and only when it has no answer.
